Anatomical LEFT hand firmly wraps the grip of ONE complete tall bamboo bow; anatomical RIGHT hand does the action; quiver remains fixed over anatomical RIGHT shoulder. Preserve costume motifs and original short body/large head ratio. Full bow tips, feet, hands, ponytail visible with transparent margin. W profile looking to screen LEFT. Keep scale and composition of image1, ground near y=940 on a 1024 canvas, fixed root around x450. NO per-frame recentering, no effect particles, no shadow floor, text or UI.
Image3 is preceding animation frame for joint continuity, but Image1 remains the fixed identity/style and scale reference. Keep body, head, bow size, camera angle, feet baseline consistent. Animate actual joints only.\nAnimation cast/W/10, phase 施法释放候选.
